purpose: Test one outcome-blind admission-frontier repair: preserve the unchanged same-seed Random command prefix, append only current placement-feasible players whose parents were complete at the start of the window, and choose the ready-tail node assignment by a frozen FaaSRank-default service-Pareto portfolio.

observed_training_diagnosis.v140_full_frontier: Three all-feasible native portfolios each failed all nine training gates. Their full-frontier dispatch admits blocked descendants as well as immediately runnable work.
observed_training_diagnosis.v141_exact_random_full_frontier: No online run was possible because unchanged Random can stop before later common-feasible players, so it cannot be a complete full-frontier candidate.
observed_training_diagnosis.v142_exact_random_prefix: All three exact-prefix treatments failed all nine gates. Across each arm and burst scenario, Random stopped early in 11994 of 12000 windows; the exact prefix admitted about 1.00-1.13 players per window while the common All frontier averaged about 5518-5571 feasible players.
observed_training_diagnosis.identified_axis: The next intervention changes cohort coverage only: from the exact Random prefix to that prefix union the current parents-completed feasible tail. It does not change Random, HPA, candidates, workload, paper welfare, SLA, or the offline-reference policy.
observed_training_diagnosis.no_parameter_search: The parents-completed predicate is a simulator state invariant, not a fitted threshold. No admission count, queue threshold, scenario branch, or performance-derived coefficient is introduced.

hypotheses.primary: The exact Random prefix under-admits immediately executable work, while the All frontier over-admits blocked descendants. Admitting the exact prefix plus every current parents-completed feasible tail player should retain Random's deterministic prefix and avoid both extremes.
hypotheses.secondary: On the shared ready-tail cohort, a frozen FaaSRank-default service-Pareto selector can retain the ready-native default unless another native expert has nonworse maximum service, strictly lower total service, and nonworse immutable-baseline paper welfare.
hypotheses.falsification: The V143 arm is falsified if it fails any of the same nine strict scenario-by-metric gates on the complete E1526-E1528 training cohort.

allowed_at_runtime: current simulator state, common-HPA placement candidates, containers, queues, node resources, configured bandwidth, and immutable function and DAG configuration
the exact persistent same-seed native Random command prefix with unchanged early-stop and RNG semantics
whether each parent is complete at the start of the current scheduling window
frozen native FaaSRank, Greedy, Hiku, Jiagu, Orion, LoadLeast, and OCS command assignments captured on private channels
current admitted immutable work, same-window projected immutable work, cold start, configured parent transfer, and immutable-baseline paper welfare
forbidden_at_runtime: completion counts, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future state, scenario or burst label, registered burst intervals, performance values, fitted coefficients, learned thresholds, or outcome feedback
information_boundary.adaptive_training_disclosure: V142 training outcomes were consulted to choose this new mechanism hypothesis. The frozen V142 baselines, tapes, and E1526-E1528 seeds are reused only for adaptive training comparison; they can never serve as V143 confirmation evidence.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any Random trace mismatch, ready-tail predicate mismatch, cohort/order mismatch, incomplete or infeasible hybrid assignment, unavailable or nonfinite certificate, provenance mismatch, or failed blind audit rejects reveal.

cohort_and_assignment_contract.random_prefix: Capture the unchanged RandomScheduler once per window with its persistent same-seed RNG. Preserve every emitted player, order position, and node ID exactly.
cohort_and_assignment_contract.ready_tail: From the same window-start state, collect every common-placement-feasible unscheduled request/function whose parents are all complete. Remove players already present in the Random prefix.
cohort_and_assignment_contract.common_cohort_order: Exact Random prefix order first, followed by ready-tail players in the stable All-frontier request/DAG order. The union contains no duplicates.
cohort_and_assignment_contract.hybrid_candidates: Every hybrid keeps Random node IDs for prefix players. For each ready-tail player it uses the corresponding exact frozen native expert node assignment from the same pre-dispatch state.
cohort_and_assignment_contract.default: The FaaSRank hybrid is index zero and remains selected unless a strict service-Pareto replacement is admissible.
cohort_and_assignment_contract.dispatch: Dispatch exactly one command for every common-cohort player and no other player. Empty cohorts emit no command.
cohort_and_assignment_contract.regression: Tests must cover Random early stop before later ready players, prefix/ready overlap, unready descendant exclusion, exact prefix node preservation, complete expert tail projection, deterministic order, and cross-window RNG continuation.

treatment.native_selection: FaaSRank default; replace only by a hybrid assignment with service maximum nonworse, service sum strictly lower, and paper welfare nonworse; choose minimum service sum, then maximum welfare, then stable native kind
treatment.nash_acceptance: same common cohort and command count; complete proposal; service maximum nonworse; service sum strictly lower; paper welfare nonworse relative to the selected hybrid initializer
treatment.numeric_rule: Only the existing 1e-6 machine comparison; no fitted tolerance or scenario branch.

training_design.independent_unit: one V142 workload tape and environment seed
training_design.candidate_run_order_rule: Use one seeded permutation of the nine frozen scenario-by-seed candidate cells; never reorder after any result or failure.

selection_rule.per_scenario_per_metric: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the maximum frozen concurrent V142 baseline mean and candidate-minus-each-baseline is strictly positive on at least two of three paired seeds
selection_rule.zero_completion: retain every run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero is zero; no imputation or seed replacement
selection_rule.confirmation: Training authorizes no paper or operational claim. A pass may only authorize generation of separately sealed E1497-E1516 confirmation inputs.

logging_and_blind_audit.per_window: Log Random RNG identity/lifecycle/prefix hash, full All-feasible count, ready-feasible count, prefix-ready overlap, final cohort/order/hash, every hybrid assignment/hash/certificate, selected kind/reason, exact dispatch equality, Nash guard evidence, and existing solver/reference observations.
logging_and_blind_audit.blind_audit: Before reveal validate the exact nine-run candidate product, attempt-1 QC, zero quarantine, ledger, runtime consensus, pairings to the 81 frozen V142 baselines, exact reuse hashes, 12 frozen tapes, nine new references, exact Random lifecycle, exact ready-tail predicate/cohort/dispatch, candidate selection, state-domain equality, and zero parsed candidate performance summaries.
